verdict.rationale: Ultrametric does install skills. `ultrametric init` writes SKILL.md files into both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) harness locations, a keyless dry-run probe confirmed this, and the files can be committed to share the setup with a team. Placing skills in the harness's native skills directories lets the agent discover them. However, no evidence shows how the skill descriptions are written, what triggers activation, or that the right skill fires at the right moment. missing for 10: skill description/frontmatter content engineered for activation, evidence of automatic triggering from task context, hands-on corroboration of correct activation.
